title: Reliability initiative traceability: decomposed error-budget tranches for multi-tenant rollouts
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Extend the Initiative Tracker to support tranche-based error budgets and explicit SLI-to-initiative mappings for multi-tenant rollouts. Background: current tracker stores a single error budget per initiative and rolls up SLI aggregates, which hides per-tenant runway and makes staged rollouts risky. We need finer-grained visibility so PMs and SREs can: 1) partition an initiative-level budget into named tranches (eg. internal-alpha, beta-partner, general-availability) with independent burn policies; 2) map individual SLIs and service-level metrics to those tranches; 3) surface automated run-rate alerts and suggested mitigation playbooks tied to each tranche; and 4) enable initiative-level OKR linking where attainment is weighted by tranche priority. Success looks like: - Initiative dashboard surfaces tranche table, current burn-rate, projected runway (hours/days) per tranche, and owner/contact per tranche - Alerting rules auto-provision when a tranche crosses configurable burn thresholds (e.g., 25%/50%/80% of error budget in rolling 7d) - Rollout controls exposed in tracker so PM/Eng can record staged percentage and link a Deployment ID or GH PR for audit - Backfill migration script to populate tranche=default for existing initiatives so nothing is lost Why this matters: Multi-tenant customers and private deployments have different risk tolerances. By tracking tranche-level budgets we can make smarter automated fallbacks (route to cheaper model variant, reduce concurrency, or pause non-critical experiments) and tie remediation work directly to initiative OKRs.
acceptance_criteria: Tracker UI has a "tranche" section that lists name, owner, SLI set, current burn and projected runway for each tranche
Ability to create and edit up to 5 tranches per initiative with per-tranche error budget (%) or absolute minutes
Automated alert templates created when tranche crosses thresholds (25, 50, 80) and links to playbook
Runway projection algorithm documented and matches simulation dashboard in staging
Backfill tool sets tranche=default for all active initiatives and records migration log
action_items: PM: finalize tranche data model and UX fields (owner, budget type, SLI list, criticality)
Eng: design API and DB migration plan; estimate storage and query cost for tranche rollups
SRE: propose default burn thresholds, playbook links, and mitigation actions for automated suggestions
Design: prototype tranche table and rollout control UI; usability test with two PM/SRE pairs
Metrics: build staging projection service and sample simulation for three initiatives
comments: 2025-11-10 Aisha Kapoor: Kickoff notes: met with SRE and infra to scope sampling rate needed for per-tranche SLI ownership. SRE asked for conservative defaults to avoid noise.

2025-11-18 Liam O'Rourke: Engineering flagged potential query perf if we compute per-tranche runways on every dashboard load; propose nightly pre-aggregation + on-demand real-time probe for the top 3 high-activity tranches.
2025-11-25 Priya Menon (SRE): Suggested mitigation policy templates: degrade to quantized model -> reduce concurrency -> cascade to fallback model. Will draft playbook and link to playbook doc.
2025-12-01 Design review: Prototype tranche table accepted with minor spacing and mobile collapse changes; design asks to include `linked-deployment` and `rollout-percent` fields.
2025-12-03 Aisha Kapoor: Updated scope to include backfill migration and an opt-in flag for initiatives older than 12 months. Assigned ENG-24321 to track the migration work.
